description: This file defines the Antispam model class for the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing anti-spam keywords in the database, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving records.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: A model class for managing antispam keywords in the database within the OpenCart admin CMS module.

methods.name: addAntispam
methods.description: Creates a new antispam record in the database with the provided keyword.

methods.name: editAntispam
methods.description: Updates an existing antispam record identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteAntispam
methods.description: Removes an antispam record from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getAntispam
methods.description: Retrieves a single antispam record by its ID.

methods.name: getAntispams
methods.description: Retrieves multiple antispam records based on filtering and sorting criteria.

methods.name: getTotalAntispams
methods.description: Returns the total count of antispam records matching filter criteria.
